# Muscle‑Building Blueprint  
**A 7‑Day, 4‑Day‑Split Program + Nutrition + Tracking**

> *Built on the evidence‑based pillars you shared (progressive overload, volume, frequency, intensity, rest, nutrition, recovery, periodization, form).  
>  Designed for a beginner‑intermediate lifter (≈70 kg, 5–6 days/week training, 4‑day split).  
>  4‑week linear phase → 2‑week deload → repeat or shift stimulus.*

---

## 1️⃣ Training Pillars (Quick Reference)

| Pillar | What the science says | Practical takeaway |
|--------|-----------------------|--------------------|
| **Progressive overload** | 5–10 % ↑ load/volume every 3–4 weeks | Log weights; add 2–5 % weight or 1–2 reps when you hit 10 reps comfortably |
| **Frequency** | 2–4 × per muscle group | Hit each major group 3 ×/week (Push, Pull, Legs, Upper‑Lower) |
| **Volume** | 18–36 reps per muscle group/week | 3–4 sets × 6–12 reps; 2–3 exercises per group |
| **Intensity** | 70–80 % 1RM for most sets | Use RPE 7–8 on the last set |
| **Rest** | 60–90 s between sets | Keep it short to build metabolic stress |
| **Nutrition** | 1.6–2.2 g kg⁻¹ protein + 250–500 kcal surplus | 2 600 kcal/day for a 70 kg man (adjust for body‑weight) |
| **Recovery** | 7–9 h sleep, 48 h rest per muscle | Prioritize sleep, foam‑roll, light cardio on off‑days |
| **Periodization** | Linear 4‑week ↑volume → ↓intensity, 2‑week deload | Repeat or change stimulus after deload |
| **Technique** | Proper form = injury prevention + better recruitment | Warm‑up, sub‑max sets, focus on mind‑muscle link |

---

## 2️⃣ 7‑Day Weekly Schedule

| Day | Focus | Key Notes |
|-----|-------|-----------|
| **Mon – Push** | Chest, Shoulders, Triceps | 4‑set, 8–10 rep scheme, last set RPE 7–8 |

| **Wed – Rest / Active Recovery** | Light cardio 20–30 min + mobility |  |

| **Fri – Upper‑Lower** | Full‑body, mixed volume | 4‑set, 8–12 rep scheme, moderate load |
| **Sat – Optional Cardio / Mobility** | 20–30 min low‑intensity or yoga | Keep it light (≤30 min) |
| **Sun – Rest** | Full recovery | Sleep ≥ 8 h, hydrate |

> **Total training days:** 5 (4‑day split + upper‑lower).  
> **Rest days:** 2 (Sun + optional Sat).  
> **Deload week:** Every 6th week → 50 % volume, light cardio.

query: My goal is fat loss but I also want to run a half marathon in 3 months, plan my week.
answer:
## 🚀 Week 1: Your Launch‑Pad to Fat‑Loss & Half‑Marathon Success  

> **You’re 3 months away from a 13.1 mi finish line and a leaner, stronger you.**  
> **This first week is all about setting the foundation—easy miles, smart strength, and fueling the fire.**  
> **Stick to the plan, track the numbers, and remember: consistency beats intensity.**

---

### 🗓️ Daily Breakdown

| Day | Session | Distance / Time | Intensity | Key Focus | Quick Action |
|-----|---------|-----------------|-----------|-----------|--------------|
| **Mon** | **Rest / Light Activity** | – | – | Gentle yoga, walking, foam‑roll | 20‑min yoga or 30‑min walk + 5 min foam‑roll |
| **Tue** | **Tempo Run** | 5 mi (≈8 min mi⁻¹) | 80‑85 % HRmax | Build lactate threshold | Warm‑up 1 mi easy, 3 mi tempo, 1 mi cool‑down |
| **Wed** | **Strength** | – | 70‑75 % 1RM | Preserve muscle, boost RMR | 3 × 12 (RPE 6‑7) on squats, deadlifts, lunges, core |
| **Thu** | **Interval** | 6 × 400 m @ 5K pace + 2 min jog | 90‑95 % HRmax | Sharpen speed, EPOC | Focus on form, full recovery |
| **Fri** | **Rest** | – | – | Optional mobility, stretch | Light mobility routine (10‑15 min) |
| **Sat** | **Long Run** | 10 mi (≈10 min mi⁻¹) | 65‑75 % HRmax | Build aerobic base | Keep 1‑2 min slower than goal race pace |
| **Sun** | **Easy Recovery Run** | 4 mi (≈12 min mi⁻¹) | 55‑65 % HRmax | Active recovery | Very relaxed pace, focus on breathing |

> **Total Mileage:** ~30 mi (≈48 km)  
> **Total Running Time:** ~4.5 h

---

### 🏋️ Strength Session (Wednesday)

| Exercise | Sets | Reps | Load | Rest |
|----------|------|------|------|------|
| Back Squat | 3 | 12 | 70 % 1RM | 90 s |
| Romanian Deadlift | 3 | 12 | 70 % 1RM | 90 s |
| Walking Lunge | 3 | 12 each leg | Bodyweight or 10 lb dumbbells | 90 s |
| Plank | 3 | 60 s | – | 60 s |
| Russian Twist | 3 | 15 each side | Light medicine ball | 60 s |

> **RPE:** 6‑7/10 (steady, controlled effort).  
> **Progression:** Add 5 lb to each lift every 2 weeks, or add 1 rep per set when you hit 12/12 comfortably.

---

### 🍎 Nutrition Snapshot

| Meal | What to Eat | Why |
|------|-------------|-----|
| **Breakfast** | Oatmeal + whey + berries + almond butter | Carb + protein to start the day |
| **Pre‑run Snack** | Banana + peanut butter | Quick carbs + energy |
| **Lunch** | Grilled chicken + quinoa + veggies | Balanced macros, satiety |
| **Post‑workout Shake** | Whey + banana + spinach | Muscle repair & glycogen refill |
| **Dinner** | Baked salmon + sweet potato + broccoli | Omega‑3s + complex carbs |
| **Snack (optional)** | Greek yogurt + honey | Protein + carbs before bed |

> **Daily Calorie Goal (Training Day):** ~2,000 kcal  
> **Macros:** 30 % protein, 40 % carbs, 30 % fat

---

### 📊 Key Metrics to Track

| Metric | Tool | Frequency | Goal |
|--------|------|-----------|------|
| Body Weight | Scale | Daily/Weekly | 0.5–1 lb/week loss |
| RHR | Smartwatch | Morning | ↓1–2 bpm per week |
| HRV | HRV‑track app | Morning | ≥70 % → ready; <70 % → cut load |
| Weekly Mileage | Strava / Garmin | Weekly | 10 % increase max |
| Sleep | Oura / Fitbit | Daily | 7–9 h, ≥85 % efficiency |
| Nutrition | MyFitnessPal | Daily | Meet calorie & macro targets |

> **Quick Check:** If HRV <70 % or RHR ↑, add an extra rest day or reduce volume that week.

---

### 💪 Motivation Nuggets

1. **You’re building a marathon‑ready body in 3 months—every mile is a step forward.**  
2. **Strength keeps you lean, speeds up your metabolism, and protects your joints—think of it as a “fat‑burner” booster.**  
3. **Your nutrition plan is designed to fuel runs, recover, and still create a safe calorie deficit.**  
4. **Track your numbers; they’re your progress compass.**  
5. **Remember: the goal is sustainable change, not a crash diet or extreme training.**  

---

### 📅 Week 1 Action List (Checklist)

1. **Mon:** Complete 20‑min yoga + 5‑min foam‑roll.  
2. **Tue:** Run 5 mi tempo; log pace & HR.  
3. **Wed:** Strength session (3×12 on each exercise).  
4. **Thu:** 6×400 m intervals; record time & recovery.  
5. **Fri:** Rest + 10‑min mobility routine.  
6. **Sat:** Long run 10 mi; maintain 65‑75 % HRmax.  
7. **Sun:** Easy run 4 mi; focus on relaxed breathing.  
8. **Daily:** Log calories, macros, water intake, sleep, HRV.  
9. **Weekly:** Weigh‑in; adjust calories if >1 lb/week loss.  
10. **Reflect:** Write 1‑2 sentences on how you felt each day—celebrate the wins!  

---

**You’ve got this.**  
Keep the plan, stay consistent, and watch the miles and the numbers stack up.  
**Let’s make Week 1 the launchpad for a stronger, leaner, faster you!**
